Explore features live · Port 8080

How it works: This page is served as a static file by Conduit. The buttons below send requests through Conduit's proxy layer to a local Node.js API on port 4000. All features shown here are configured in demo/conduit.json.

Response Timing & Headers

Open browser DevTools → Network tab, then click any button above. You'll see X-Response-Time, X-Powered-By: Conduit, and security headers on every response.

Config file demo/conduit.json
Static root demo/dist/
Proxy /api → http://localhost:4000 (stripPrefix: true)
Rate limit 300 req / 60 s
SPA fallback enabled
Compression enabled (br / gzip)
